feature_policy: chronological pooled or local fit; known_future explicitly declared, past x fixed lag; no whole-data fit
scope: Aligned regular panel; rolling-origin gap+embargo excluded from fit; held final targets not used during development
warning: Diagnostic tests do not prove stationarity or predictive success. Coverage not guaranteed after regime/parameter/covariate change.

provenance.scope: chronological origin fit; development diagnostics only; no final target choice
provenance.seed_reason: seeded whole-series KMeans; deterministic numerical forecasting otherwise

series_task.scope: development prefix only; each entire series is one sample; no forecast accuracy claim
series_task.warning: Alignment and scaling define distance. Clusters are exploratory, not real classes or predictive success.

experiment_capture.config_scope: full TimeSeriesSpec including temporal protocol, availability, method and parameters
experiment_capture.data_access_time: captured before scheduling; run.data_access_at records first immutable snapshot read boundary

interpretation: Bu projede önceki final test kullanımı yok; proje dışı kullanım bilinmez.
